children: AIB Data Centers executed two linked acquisitions in Texas totaling approximately $17.2 million to develop a data center campus spanning about 29.385 acres. The company bought 5.00 acres for $8.25 million with existing infrastructure supported by 15 MW of primary power. Concurrently, it agreed to acquire 100% of an LLC holding rights to 24.385 adjacent acres for $8.98 million, with $2.98 million paid at closing and a $6.0 million deferred installment due upon energization of Property B facilities. The second site is backed by a utility facilities extension agreement targeting up to 40 MW of primary power, supporting future AI and HPC workloads.
